label: t19 = t16 with the stage-98 shrunk effects (k 4) instead of raw, amplitude 1.576: K562, CD4, HCT116 at equal weights, gamma 1, trial-01 generator
claim_type: prediction registered before generation and submission; not a measurement
evidence_used: reports/banco_varianti_2026-09-25/CORREZIONE.md and CP-0039: on held-out public sources the shrunk effects raise the pds proxy by +0.011..+0.022 at k 4 (r7, paired bootstrap, every interval above zero); in the generator model (r8) shrunk at 1.576 moves about as many genes as t16 and beats its pds proxy by +0.004..+0.019 and the sign precision of its detectable genes by +0.003..+0.008. The same model overestimated t16's pds gain (CP-0037), and it does not simulate the generator's spurious calls or the Wilcoxon: the DE members are the main uncertainty.

reading_rule_fixed_before_the_result.t19 <= t16 - 0.005: the proxy gain does not reach the official score: keep raw effects
reading_rule_fixed_before_the_result.otherwise: inconclusive; keep raw effects, the tested reference
